title: Flow Capital plans to tokenize $150M private credit fund via DigiFT: Report
summary: Bloomberg reported Flow Capital plans to tokenize its private credit fund to raise additional capital, but crypto execs warn tokenization doesn’t magically make hard-to-trade assets liquid.

title: Tempo’s ‘Zones’ sparks debate over privacy in crypto infrastructure
summary: Tempo’s new “Zones” feature offers private, permissioned stablecoin transactions on its layer-1 for enterprises, but critics warn the operator‑controlled design adds back centralized trust.

title: Ethereum NFT platform Foundation shuts down after failed Blackdove sale
summary: Foundation is shutting down after a failed sale to Blackdove, having processed about $230 million in NFT primary sales since its launch in 2021.

title: Tokenization doesn’t ‘magically’ fix illiquid assets: PBW 2026
summary: Industry speakers at Paris Blockchain Week said tokenization can broaden access and issuance, but it does not by itself create active secondary markets for illiquid assets.

title: Texas man in $20M Meta-1 Coin fraud sentenced to 23 years in prison
summary: Meta-1 Coin was sold and marketed from 2018 to 2023 as an investment backed by $44 billion in gold and $1 billion in artworks, which turned out to be fictional.

title: Crypto in sustained winter as CEX volumes drop 39% in Q1: CoinGecko
summary: March was the “weakest month" with $800 billion in centralized crypto exchange trading volume, the lowest since November 2023.

title: Cybersecurity researcher uncovers fake Ledger sold on Chinese marketplace
summary: The researcher said they examined the fake Ledger device’s firmware and found signs pointing to a Chinese semiconductor company named Espressif Systems.

title: Ethereum Foundation-funded program exposes 100 DPRK workers in crypto
summary: The Ketman Project, funded by an Ethereum Foundation stipend, identified 100 North Korean IT workers and alerted about 53 projects employing DPRK operatives.

title: At least a dozen crypto entities attacked since Drift Protocol hack
summary: Rhea Finance and the Russia-linked Grinex exchange were hacked for a combined $21 million over the past two days.

title: Zanzibar police probe crypto exec Joe McCann after fiancée’s death
summary: Zanzibar police are reportedly holding Asymmetric founder Joe McCann for questioning after the death of his fiancée, Ashly Robinson.
